scope: Measured 20Hz phase with independent GPU thread and real zero-motion hold actions on missed action availability. Whole bank startup pauses sim and is charged separately; no free prediction overlap. Twelve initial task states held out from original exploratory 0/4 feature study. Gate thresholds fixed before this run; one real-time repetition per condition. Second timing repetition of the SAME 12 states, reverse task/state ordering. Not 12 new independent conditions. Confirm response/physics sensitivity to scheduler timing before final conclusions.
prediction_horizons: First 16 control steps only, rolling 16, or entire remaining 128/192-step evaluation window. K=4 and H=50 in every arm.
perturbation: Applied translational action commands scaled by 0.98 in real execution only, after shared prefix. Nominal simulator predictor uses gain 1. Rotation/gripper unchanged.
timing: Sequential simulation; measured planning wall time includes past replay and future rendering. Post-arrival latency includes input processing, selection, sparse MLP, dense attention, one flow step and decode. No concurrency claim.
